conventions.implementation_source: User's frozen spec only; do not import or read existing harness/research until own numbers are produced
conventions.universe: Use the 99 literal listed tickers; heading says100. Do not add UNH or any other ticker to repair heading.
conventions.ticker_aliases: Query BRK.B and BRK/B for ticker-filtered disclosure histories and option metadata; deduplicate returned contracts by option ticker.
conventions.initial_spot_lookback: Endpoint range t_pre minus7 calendar days through t_pre inclusive. Last available close; no3session age filter for this step.
conventions.ties: Nearest strike chooses lower on ties; expiry chooses earlier on equal distance to120days. Missing-strike retry chooses nearest untried tocurrentstrike. Preserve last successful estimate if laterattempts fail.
conventions.multiple_tickers_per_cik_day: Choose lexicographically first universe ticker after exploding, report any such ambiguous CIK-days. Never change based on returns.
conventions.standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation, ddof=1; per-trade Sharpe is mean/sample std without annualization.
conventions.peer_draws: For each seed initialize Python random.Random(seed); sample6 from sortedeligible list for each unique kept filing date in ascendingdate order continuously2024-2026. Same date uses onebasket across issuers. Drawbeforeknowingpeerpricevalidity; never refillmissing peers. Priceonlydrawsneededforvalid event dates. Meanuses availablevalidpeertrades; report missingcounts.
conventions.costs: Exactly twice entry halfspread. No exitquote substitution, nocommissions, no stricter freshness/size filters. This reproduces a modeled cost, not actual executable trade prices.
conventions.periods: Windows classifybyfilingdate.2024-25 events may exit in2026 and Aug2026 events may exit inSep2026, subject tolastcompleted session. This follows frozen rule; no arbitrary window-end censoring.
conventions.fixed_rule: No parameter, source selection or eligibility rule will be tuned to referencecounts or returns. Implementation defects corrected with notes.
